text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Air Groove talking to both dorm leaders in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, it isn't realistic for us to be buying luxury goods.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But many of the academy students come from wealthy families… What can we do to satisfy them without breaking the bank?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Grah, we're not gettin' anywhere! You're all wastin' way too much time sweatin' the small stuff!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All you gotta do is wash your tail, blow dry it, and you're done! It's that simple!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Improper tail care can harm a racer's performance. We cannot afford to scrimp on such vital products.
choice_data_list: Are you talking about tail-care products?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Eavesdropping, were you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Apologies for keeping Air Groove from you, but we wanted her opinion on this matter as the student council vice president, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: To fill you in, we've been receiving requests from our residents for a greater variety of tail-care products.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume's tail forms an important part of her physique. It affects the body's overall balance.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: In extreme cases, poor tail care can even impair the movement of the legs.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's especially important for Umamusume who race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For this reason, many students bring in their own products. However, not everyone can afford such luxuries.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I get that we gotta make sure no student gets left behind, no matter their circumstances…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But c'mon! There's way too many to choose from! We can't please everyone!
choice_data_list: I'll try and think of something too.
I'll try and think of something too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But c'mon! There's way too many to choose from! We can't please everyone!
choice_data_list: I'll try and think of something too.
I'll try and think of something too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Am I hearing things? You may not have noticed, but you don't have a tail.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hold on! Input from someone without a tail could be just the new perspective we need!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You raise a fair point. I suppose it's true that trainers are well-versed in Umamusume affairs.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Very well. I'll allow it. First, I'll run you through the opinions we've heard so far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Air Groove's approval, I join the discussion, contributing my own thoughts as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your help back there in the cafeteria. I think we have a better idea of what new products to bring in now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Still, it's a little strange to think about. Having a tail is so normal for us, yet for you, it's something you've never known.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder what it'd be like if you did have a tail…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For one, I imagine I'd give you a strict talking-to every morning about proper tail care.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove smiles ever so slightly as she shares her words of affection.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We have our own unique problems, and you have yours. I suppose there's no harm in that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, I forgot to ask! What do you use, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Me? I generally use…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Bar soap.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Wha… Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahaha! Soap! Bar soap at that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You, the kinda gal who looks like she'd only use high-end conditioners! Using bar soap! Ahahah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What are you laughing at?! There's nothing funny about using naturally-sourced soap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Umamusume have to deal with a lot more than I had initially thought. I promise myself to do all that I can to support them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I imagine Air Groove will be using her favorite bar of soap later today in order to maintain her tail's luster.
